caption: The drawing depicts an ornate hair comb centered on a solid black rectangular background. The comb is rendered in shades of gold and brown, with intricate openwork designs in its upper section. This upper portion consists of three main rounded lobes arranged in a clover or trefoil pattern, each filled with a swirling foliate motif. The central lobe is the largest, flanked by two slightly smaller lobes, and all three are bordered by a thin, continuous outer edge. At the base of the decorative section, the comb extends downward into four long, narrow tines. The artwork is framed by a wide border of blank, off-white space surrounding the black rectangle.
title: Comb
